spans.s:
a-cara, a. not moving; as subst. plant (as
distinguished from animals).

ācāra, m. walk and conversation; conduct;
usage; observance. [√car + ā.]
a-cala, a. immovable; as m. mountain.

ācamana, n. the rinsing of the mouth.
[√cam + ā.]

ācamanīya, m. dish for use in rinsing
the mouth. [ācamana, 1215.]

ācāryà, m. teacher, esp. of the Veda.
[perhaps, ‘the man of observances,’ fr.
ācāra, 1212d 4.]
